clips.title: SpaceX首发高评级债券 现金超千亿仍融资 为未来项目铺路

subtitles.en: It feels like we were only here a week ago when it came to Nvidia.
subtitles.zh: 感觉就像上周才聊过英伟达。

subtitles.en: This idea, you have a lot of cash. Why tap the bond market?
subtitles.zh: 既然现金充裕，为何还要发债？

subtitles.en: What does it mean for SpaceX to be going into this arena?
subtitles.zh: SpaceX进入这个市场意味着什么？

subtitles.en: Yeah, because SpaceX also confirmed that as of June 19th, it's sitting on more than $100 billion of cash anyway.
subtitles.zh: 是的，因为SpaceX也确认截至6月19日，它坐拥超过1000亿美元现金。

subtitles.en: But for them, it's kind of like a treasury management issue. They're going to use this in all-rebonne sale to pay down and refinance existing debt.
subtitles.zh: 但对他们来说，这更像是一个资金管理问题。他们将用这笔高等级债券销售来偿还和再融资现有债务。

subtitles.en: But there's a big longer-term view, which is that SpaceX is many, many light years away from positive free cash flow.
subtitles.zh: 但从长远来看，SpaceX距离正自由现金流还有很长的路要走。

subtitles.en: And they are going into a world where they're going to have to spend incredibly aggressively.
subtitles.zh: 他们将进入一个必须极度激进支出的世界。

subtitles.en: And this is just one mechanism to keep that balance sheet in the order that they will need for all of the projects
subtitles.zh: 这只是保持资产负债表有序的一种机制，以满足招股说明书中列出的所有项目需求。

subtitles.en: that they outlined in the prospectus. Yeah, I mean, SpaceX, as we heard from Bruce Richards, I think early last week, is just the biggest rising star out there.
subtitles.zh: 是的，正如我们上周早些时候从Bruce Richards那里听到的，SpaceX就是目前最大的新星。

subtitles.en: They had debt at more than 12%.
subtitles.zh: 他们的债务利率曾超过12%。

subtitles.en: And they've managed to cut that to four. I'm guessing this will be around there as well.
subtitles.zh: 他们已经削减到四个。我猜这次也会差不多。

subtitles.en: What's the story with the Microsoft Chevron deal? It doesn't have the hype or the excitement of SpaceX.
subtitles.zh: 微软雪佛龙的交易怎么样？它没有SpaceX那样的炒作和兴奋点。

subtitles.en: But it's a pretty big number. Yeah, it's 2.6 gigawatts ramped up two over time,
subtitles.zh: 但数字相当大。是的，2.6吉瓦，随时间逐步提升，

subtitles.en: starting in 2028, but for natural gas.
